play_plan.meaning: Race engineer gives the number of laps still to run in a long race ('X laps to go (long)'). X is spoken inside the clip; one clip covers one fixed N.
play_plan.when_it_should_play: Race only (SessionType 7, RacePhase 5 green flag). Player only. Long races only: the threshold for 'long' is UNKNOWN in code.

play_plan.must_not_play_when: Qualifying/practice (SessionType 1-6); laps_remaining == 1 (final-lap line 273 instead); AI-only laps

play_plan.calibration: Which N the clip voices (listen once); threshold for 'long' race: UNKNOWN
play_plan.live_test: Owner: race with TotalRaceLaps >= the N in the clip; drive until laps_remaining equals N. Requires the carrier change first (agent-side work, not run by the agent).
play_plan.confidence: GUESS: carrier technique proven for other lines; N and 'long' are not in code. Raise by listening to the clip and finding the race-length rule.

play_plan.meaning: Race engineer marks that the race is a quarter complete (25% of the race distance).
play_plan.when_it_should_play: Race (SessionType 7, RacePhase 5 green flag). Player only. Once per race, when the player has completed 25% of the race distance.
play_plan.trigger: progress = (player_completed_laps + lap_fraction) / TotalRaceLaps >= 0.25. TotalRaceLaps 0x8ACF8C is post-reduction and truncated (FACT findings.jsonl:80). player_completed_laps = player lap counter (DERIVED, +16444). lap_fraction = player lap distance veh+0x4044 / lap length (lap length UNKNOWN; calibrate live).
play_plan.subject: player (-1)
play_plan.latch_cooldown: once per session (latch set when fired; cleared at session start). Cooldown 1.0 s cannot gate a threshold (findings.jsonl:76).
play_plan.must_not_play_when: Qualifying/practice; replay; if the player retired or pitted before 25% (owner decision needed); when the 25% point coincides with the final-lap window (check ordering in short races)
play_plan.conflicts: Final-lap line 273 (only at one lap to go); pit lines (shared cooldown family); MF tokens (DD-07) if a line is pending on eid 274
play_plan.calibration: lap length per track; exact truncation rule for TotalRaceLaps (FACT findings.jsonl:80)
play_plan.live_test: Owner: race of known lap count (e.g. 4 laps). After completing lap 1 of 4 the line should fire once. Agent cannot run the game.
play_plan.confidence: DERIVED: trigger inputs exist (TotalRaceLaps FACT; lap counter and distance DERIVED). Raise by a live read of +16444 and +0x4044 across a lap.
